name: Ningbo TIP Rubber Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Ningbo TIP Rubber Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive development, manufacturing, and global distribution of advanced polymer fluid transfer and sealing solutions primarily for the automotive industry. Their extensive product line includes various types of hoses such as water, fuel, and hydraulic conduits, as well as custom-molded components, integrated assemblies, specialized rubber compounds, and precision-engineered metal and plastic parts. The company was established in 2009 and operates from its headquarters in Ninghai, China.
